title: factory-dev-slot app
description: How to run one app's dev server in a per-worktree container. Lives in <project>/.agents/factory-metadata/dev-slot.json or in an installed companion's apps/<name>.json.

name.description: The app name: the project name (factory-context) by default, and the file name for a companion's apps/<name>.json.

image.description: Image to run. With `dockerfile`, the local tag it is built to; without, a ready image such as node:24.

dockerfile.description: Optional worktree-relative Dockerfile that runs the dev server with the worktree bind-mounted at /app. Built to `image` when it changes.

command.description: Optional shell command run in the container (sh -c) in /app instead of the image's own command: install dependencies, then start the dev server bound to 0.0.0.0.

scheme.description: What the dev server speaks. Default https.

containerPort.description: Port the dev server binds inside the container, and on the host when run without a slot.

healthPath.description: Path that returns 200 once the dev server is ready.

portRange.description: [first, last] host ports slots may take, bound on 127.0.0.1 only.

memoryGiB.description: Peak memory one slot needs; up queues while Docker's total cannot fit one more.

idleMinutes.description: gc removes a slot no slot command has touched for this long. Default 60.

certDir.description: Worktree-relative, gitignored dev-cert directory, copied from the main checkout when a worktree lacks it so the trusted cert is reused.

sessionPrefix.description: Browser session name prefix; the slot appends its slug. Default: the app name.

baseUrl.description: Env var `slot env` sets to the base URL. Default DEV_SLOT_BASE_URL.

session.description: Env var `slot env` sets to the browser session name. Default DEV_SLOT_SESSION.

proxyPort.description: Optional env var `slot env` sets to the slot port + 1000, for an auth proxy.
